params.message:
A removed teacher no longer takes her feedback, or Deel 1, with her

Removing a staff member marked the user DELETED for every school, and the
User scope then hid her as the author of her feedback. Report preparation
read feedback.teacher.first_name on null and dropped the whole
basisvorming section for the pupils she had written for (athena OV4,
2026-10-23).

- Feedback and every creator relation drop User::NOT_REMOVED_SCOPE, so an
  author stays known; EveryAuthorStaysKnownTest walks every model.
- Vue and the student page read the author with a guard.
- Removing a staff member detaches them from the selected school; the
  user is DELETED only when no school is left.

Portal: De rubriek basisvorming in de rapportvoorbereiding verschijnt weer, ook wanneer een leerkracht uit Naviskore verwijderd werd.
